exposure: diagnostic criteria for gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM)
change in gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) diagnostic criteria
cohort: Pregnant women at a regional hospital, four months before and after the change in GDM guidelines was implemented
finding: Despite the change in guidelines, there was a non-significant increase in the incidence of diagnosis of gestational diabetes.
mod_finding: Instrumental deliveries increased following the change in guidelines (p = 0.01).
